Definition: first, in place, time or rank (as adjective or noun)
BiblicalUsage: Scripture uses riʼshôwn for first, in place, time or rank (as adjective or noun). It stands in 1 Chronicles 9:2, "Now the first inhabitants that in their possessions…", and in 1 Kings 13:6, "…the man of God, Intreat now the face…".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe riʼshôwn is worth knowing, because nothing in Scripture is there by accident.
